siteContent.bannerText: Admissions open for 2026-2027 academic session. Limited seats per batch.
siteContent.heroSubheadline: We don't just teach equations. We build a fundamental understanding of matter that translates directly to top percentiles in NEET and JEE.
siteContent.aboutHeading: A legacy of making chemistry intuitive
siteContent.aboutParagraph1: Since 2016, Attri Chemistry Classes has been breaking down complex chemical phenomena into logical, digestible concepts. We believe memorization is the enemy of science.
siteContent.aboutParagraph2: Our methodology focuses on the 'why' before the 'how'. When students understand the underlying physical reasons behind organic mechanisms or inorganic trends, chemistry transforms from a burden into a scoring subject.

methodology.title: Diagnose
methodology.detail: A baseline paper and a chapter-wise gap map in the first week, so teaching starts from where the student actually is.

methodology.title: Build
methodology.detail: Concepts from first principles. Derivations on the board, mechanisms drawn step by step, no shortcut before the logic.

methodology.title: Drill
methodology.detail: Daily practice problems with video solutions, weekly timed sets and a personal error notebook that travels with you.

methodology.title: Simulate
methodology.detail: Full NEET and JEE pattern papers every Sunday, graded on the same marking scheme as the real examination.

features.title: Micro batches
features.description: Never more than 25 students. Personal attention isn't a promise, it's structurally guaranteed.

features.title: Doubt resolution
features.description: 1-on-1 sessions every weekend. We don't move to the next chapter until every hand goes down.

faqs.question: How large are the batches?
faqs.answer: Batches are capped at 18 students for entrance programmes and 20 for board and foundation programmes. Seats are not added mid-session.

faqs.question: Can my child attend a demo before enrolling?
faqs.answer: Yes. Every student gets three free demo lectures and one doubt session before the fee is due. No card or advance payment is collected for the demo.
